lead_headline: Risica, the long-delayed Milanese pizzeria from Il Posto's Andrea Frizzi, finally opens in Five Points

restaurant.blurb: 5 new leads today: The Couloir (après bar, Overland), Risica (Milanese pizza, Five Points), and three Dairy Queen closures across Regis and Fort Logan.

liquor.blurb: 4 new applications today: Padel Haus filed for entertainment license at Welton St (Five Points), Hammer and Nails Men's Grooming Shop applied for beer/wine at Newport St, Don Panchon Mexican Restaurant seeks hotel/restaurant license near Tower Rd, while Barro Baro's tavern application at Larimer St (RiNo) was closed administratively. La Reyna Azteca and Park Avenue Tacos both moved from delinquent to expired.

reputation.blurb: 2 mentions today push the 7-day total to 53 across 14 sources — down from 62 the prior week but maintaining steady flow. Instagram continues to lead with 21 pickups this week, while The Denver Post and Facebook each contributed 7 citations. Recent highlights include Mayor Hancock's historic building purchase and the Marketplace expansion story. Google News RSS drove 51 of the 53 weekly mentions.

subscriptions.blurb: Flat yesterday (0 net: 1 new, 1 canceled) nudges MTD to +5 and holds 90-day net at +136. The past week delivered +8 net — matching the prior week exactly — with Apr 7's +4 spike offsetting choppy mid-week performance. Despite day-to-day volatility (Apr 2 posted −4, Apr 6 −1), the monthly average (+0.6/day) trails well behind the YTD pace of +1.4/day, suggesting April is softer than Q1's momentum.
